description: Aspire now exposes configuration for the base image used by DCP's container network tunnel, via `aspire config set containerTunnel.baseImage`, the `DcpPublisher:ContainerTunnelBaseImage` setting, or the `--dcp-container-tunnel-base-image` argument. This lets environments that require a customized or mirrored image configure the tunnel without modifying DCP directly.
name: Configurable container tunnel base image
